name: ci-polling
title: CI Polling & Auto-Fix
description: Polls CI status every N seconds until done, then summarizes failures
author: SolSolis-Sys

agents.prompt: Check CI status for run {{run_id}} using `gh run view {{run_id}}`. Return: {status: 'pending'|'success'|'failure', summary: str}
Given these CI failures: {{failures}}. Identify root cause and suggest fix for each.
